name: kernel-closure-cases
goal: Record actual ordinary JSON kernelClosure calls under its own unit and reject missing or misattributed captures without altering semantics

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.

Existing runtime and 8 semantic guards remain correct and unchanged. Repair concerns future recorded ordinary JSON evidence, with honest historical gaps.
